notes.title: Patch Notes – 10/11/2024
notes.notes:
[h2]XR Configuration Updates:
[/h2][h3]Initial Player Orientation[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player orientation at the start of each scene has been corrected to match the XR room setup.
[/list]
[h3]Default Control Mappings
[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Accept button is now set to the Trigger by default, replacing A/X.
[*] Grip changes can now be made by pressing Up on the Joystick while holding the disc, reducing accidental changes when picking up a disc.
[/list]

[h2]Updates to Magic Hazards:
[/h2][h3]Wildcard Hazards[/h3]
[list]
[*] All hazards except Breakable Boxes now work with any disc type, removing the need for disc-hazard matching.
[/list]
[h3]Hazard Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some hazards have been added and removed, and placements have been modified. Most hazards have had their strength reduced.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a ghost controller would appear after using the game menu.
[*] Fixed a missing controller mapping for teleporting to the Catch Cam location on Oculus controllers. You can now teleport to a location near the disc flight with X while the disc is in the air.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes – 10/03/2024
notes.notes:
[h2][h1]New Features:
[/h1][/h2][h3]Test Putters Added[/h3]
A new set of test putters has been introduced and automatically added to your bag! This initial wave includes six putters with a mix of overstable, neutral, and flippy characteristics. These putters are designed with a gentler turn/fade and improved glide, but no flight ratings have been provided yet.

[b]Community Feedback Request:[/b]
After testing these putters, please send feedback on how they fly. Let us know your thoughts on potential flight ratings, any unrealistic flight behavior, or how the putters feel overall. If you find a favorite, we’d love to know! More putters will be added as we continue testing.

[h3]Putter Release Sensitivity Setting[/h3]
A new setting allows you to fine-tune Putter Release Sensitivity. This will later be integrated into the Grip Profile, but for now, it should help adjust your release when using the auto-release feature.

[b]Note:[/b] Upshots may be affected by this setting temporarily. If it's interfering with your throws, you can match it to the Throw Release setting until further updates are made.

[h2]Changes & Improvements:[/h2]
[h3]Guiding Line Temporarily Removed[/h3]
The guiding line, previously meant to assist in locating the basket, has been removed for clarity. The basket icon already serves this purpose well. There was some confusion over this line being a true throw-line guide, which is a feature planned for the future.

[h3]Performance Enhancements[/h3]
General optimizations have been made throughout the game, particularly improving performance during throws. While more updates are in the works, these current enhancements should improve overall quality of life (QoL).

[b]Note:[/b] After this update, you may need to readjust your settings.

notes.title: Playtest #2 is live tonight!
notes.notes:
Our 2nd playtest is starting tonight, and will run for several weeks. There have been many updates since our first playtest, and we're in a great place to continue to add additional content in preparation for our Early Release. 

We need your help! The more feedback and bugs we find during this period, the faster we can deliver the full vision of Disc Dimension to our players. The first playtest was invaluable for setting the direction of the experience, and we're hoping to get even more involvement with this playtest.

Please invite your friends to Request Access on our Steam Page, and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/XBp8R7gbnS]Discord[/url] to communicate directly with the development team!

Have fun!

notes.title: Last Weekend for Disc Dimension Playtest #1!
notes.notes:
Happy weekend everyone!  We're nearing the end of our first playtest, and the last day you will have access to play is Sunday, February 25th.  Everyone who requested an invite has been given access!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/PXzcVheNpfc]Here's a little hype montage to get you motivated![/url]

We'd love to hear from you if you've played the game, please don't be shy! Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/XBp8R7gbnS]Discord[/url] to give some feedback. We'd love to know what you'd like in a Disc Golf Adventure game, and we've already started to iterate based on the information we've received.

Thank you to everyone who's participated! We truly appreciate everyone's interest. Stay tuned! Early Access, the [i]full 18 hole[/i] Elder Forest course, 20 Discs, and a free 3-hole Demo is on the way.  We'll also have future Playtests when there is a major update or content drop.

notes.title: Playtest End Date Announcement - February 25th
notes.notes:
Our first playtest will end on February 25th - marking the last date you'll be able to access the game on Steam until we launch our demo and Early Access very soon!

Please get your rounds in before then, and there's still time left for you to claim a free Early Access game key by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/XBp8R7gbnS]Discord[/url], filling out a beta testing feedback form, and DMing a developer in Discord.  Hurry soon while the keys last!

Thank you all for participating in the playtest, and we hope you'll be back during Early Access to help us continue to improve the experience!

notes.title: Playtesting Has Started!
notes.notes:
Welcome to the first Playtest of Disc Dimension!  We’re excited that you’re here, and we’re thrilled to share the game with you! Please join our Discord to participate: https://discord.com/invite/XBp8R7gbnS


The game is still in development, and this initial Playtest will be focused on 3 areas: Performance, Flow, and Feel.  Essentially we want to answer: Does it run well? Is playing the game easy and intuitive? How does it feel to play Disc Golf in the game?

To help guide feedback, we’ve created a [url=https://forms.gle/BuCfd3gE6Ctb94PH7]Survey[/url] you can fill out once for this round of Playtesting. Please get used to the game, play a few sessions, and then fill out the form at your convenience.

Please feel free to discuss issues in the #feedback channel, and communicate any feature ideas you have in the #feature-ideas channel!  We consider any idea to be valid, and we will do our best to incorporate your feedback into the game.  We have a thread of Known Issues pinned in the Feedback channel. If you see a piece of feedback or a feature idea in the channel already, please just add an emoji to the post instead of making a new entry.

We will announce an end date for this round of Playtesting sometime in the next few weeks.  Until then, we may introduce small patches to fix issues as they come up.

Welcome to the Disc Dimension, and enjoy!
